notes: Added missing core logic and allowlist enforcement stories to complete feature coverage.

stories.title: Allowlist Enforcement Logic
stories.description: Implement strict allowlist validation inside tool_router to ensure only explicitly registered tools can be executed, rejecting any unknown or unauthorized tool calls before dispatch.

stories.title: Pydantic Validation Execution Pipeline
stories.description: Build the runtime validation pipeline that applies Pydantic schemas to incoming tool inputs, handles validation errors gracefully, and ensures only validated payloads reach domain services.

stories.title: Tool Dispatch Execution Layer
stories.description: Implement the core dispatch mechanism that maps validated tool requests to the correct facade or domain service methods and returns structured responses to the agent loop.

stories.title: Anthropic Tool Use Block Parsing
stories.description: Implement parsing logic for Anthropic tool_use blocks, extracting tool name, arguments, and correlation with chat history to support correct routing and execution.
